description: Pending payload validation through a generated crate: gen schema generates a committed self-contained schema whose contribution payload binds against the text member of the referenced setting under fixture-value, a known binding codec no processor installs, twice into scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical; the generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template. The compiled processor, naming every kdlith type it spells through the generated crate alone, collects a committed data document as a reading linked under complete scope through its generated reader: each payload streams as a pending item with its raw value, the one fitting its String member passes, the two values for that member fail KDLITH-REF005, and the payload whose reference resolves to nothing fails KDLITH-REF001 alone, its payload never validated, the link diagnostic before the payload diagnostic, and the reading fails; linked under local scope the same diagnostics are reported and the reading does not fail, each as vet data reports it on the same input
